def light_rig():
    # key
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=(0.6, -1.4, 1.2))
    k = bpy.context.object
    k.data.energy = 400; k.data.size = 2.2
    k.rotation_euler = (math.radians(50), 0, math.radians(20))
    # rim (neon-tinted, from behind/above)
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=(-0.8, 1.2, 0.9))
    r = bpy.context.object
    r.data.energy = 250; r.data.size = 1.6
    r.data.color = (0.3, 1.0, 0.8)
    r.rotation_euler = (math.radians(-130), 0, math.radians(-25))
    # fill
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=(0.2, -0.8, -0.7))
    f = bpy.context.object
    f.data.energy = 60; f.data.size = 2.0
    f.rotation_euler = (math.radians(120), 0, 0)

def cam(loc, look_at, fov=28):
    bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=loc)
    c = bpy.context.object
    direction = (look_at[0] - loc[0], look_at[1] - loc[1], look_at[2] - loc[2])
    # point -Z at target
    import mathutils
    c.rotation_euler = mathutils.Vector(direction).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    c.data.angle = math.radians(fov)
    bpy.context.scene.camera = c
    return c

def render(path, w, h):
    sc = bpy.context.scene
    sc.render.resolution_x = w
    sc.render.resolution_y = h
    sc.render.filepath = path
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
